preconditions.description: The input string A is non-empty.
The length of the input string A is between 1 and 30 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string A are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in output)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output string are lowercase Latin letters.
The output string is a substring of the input string A.

postconditions.expression: max_repeat_count = max(count_substring(output, A) for output in possible_outputs)
postconditions.description: The output string has the maximum repeat count among all possible substrings of A.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == max(len(o) for o in possible_outputs if count_substring(o, A) == max_repeat_count)
postconditions.description: In case of a tie, the output string has the maximum length among all substrings with the maximum repeat count.
In case of a tie for maximum length, the output string is the alphabetically latest substring.
